m: सम्-˚बोधन mfn. (partly fr. Caus.) awaking, arousing, MBh.
perceiving, noticing, observing, MBh.
recognizing, MaitrUp.
the act of causing to know, reminding, MBh.; Hariv.
calling to, Pāṇ. ii, 3, 47
the vocative case or its termination, Siddh.; Subh.
सम्-˚बोधयितृ mfn. (fr. Caus.) causing to know, informing, MaitrUp.
सम्-˚बोधि f. (with Buddhists) perfect knowledge or enlightenment, MWB. 43 (˚ध्य्-अङ्ग n. an ‘integral part of perfect knowledge or enlightenment’, Lalit.)
सम्-˚बोधित mfn. fully warned, duly apprised, MBh.
सम्-˚बोध्य mfn. to be enlightened or instructed, Pañcat.; Kathās.

सम्-√ ब्रू P. Ā. -ब्रवीति, -ब्रूते, to speak well, converse, RV.; (Ā.) to talk together, agree, ib.; to say anything to (acc.), MBh.

सम्-√ बुध् Ā. -बुध्यते (pr. p. -बुध्यमान, q.v.), to wake up, MBh.; R.; to perceive or understand thoroughly, notice, observe, know, ib. &c.: Caus. -बोधयति, to cause to wake up, rouse, R.; to cause to know, inform, advise, instruct; teach (two acc.), MBh.; Kāv. &c.; to call to, MBh., Kāś. on Pāṇ. i, 2, 33; to cause to agree, MW. : Desid. of Caus. See सम्-बुबोधयिषु.
सम्-बुध्यमान mfn. being quite aware, MBh.
सम्-बुबोधयिषु mfn. (fr. Desid. of Caus.) wishing to arouse or make attentive, MBh.
wishing to convert, HPariś.
